scope: Post-hoc development controls on six already-seen INR geometries; no selector, confirmatory effect, natural-image Gaussian assumption, or novelty claim
input: Read-only inr-phase-development-run-v1; observations y/coords/xy read before freeze, clean/truth and old FF predictions only after all 24 outputs SHA-frozen
geometry: Same HR64 point observations and (x+.5,y+.5)/64 coordinates; 512 observations including duplicate phases. Only horizontal phase changes, vertical stride remains 4. Phase observation sets are not nested. Periodic horizontal/vertical maxgap is a geometric description; kernels are nonperiodic. Save exact integer squared-distance histogram from every shave4 target pixel to the unique observed xy using nonperiodic Euclidean distance. Integer shave4 phase01/02 targets may share nearest-distance histograms despite continuous periodic maxgap 3/2; neither scalar distance nor maxgap is asserted to cause PSNR differences.

models.fixed_rf: phi(v)=[cos(2*pi*v*B.T),sin(2*pi*v*B.T)]/sqrt256; B from old FF checkpoint CPU buffer, sigma3/10 seed0, not from re-initialization; this is linear readout and not equivalent to trained four-layer FF NTK
models.hyperparameters: Fixed before this control; no sigma/lambda/amplitude search and no truth-derived tuning

solver.algorithm: dense Cholesky, no added jitter or fallback regularization

outputs: Save raw/clamped HR64 prediction, full linear response W=Kto*(Koo+lambda I)^-1, posterior coefficients, original B, all indices, posterior variance diagonal and observed-kernel eigenvalues. Save source/input/output SHA and all residual/finite checks before scoring.
variance: diag(Ktt-Kto*(Koo+lambda I)^-1*Kot), under each model's own fixed prior. It is neither empirically calibrated uncertainty nor actual natural-image risk; report full and shave4 regions.
score: Read clean and truth only after full cohort freeze. Noiseless prediction=.5+W*(clean-.5); deterministic-truth expected raw MSE=bias^2+noise_variance*mean_row_sum(W^2). Realized raw error decomposes as mean(bias^2)+mean((W*(y-clean))^2)+2*mean(bias*(W*(y-clean))). Report unclamped/clamped RGB MSE/PSNR full/shave4. Expectation is over new iid observation noise at fixed clean/truth; one saved noise draw does not estimate population risk or validate the prior. Clamping is nonlinear and has no claimed analytic risk identity.
old_ff: Score saved old FF raw/clamped outputs after freeze, no retraining. Linear controls fix mean .5, kernel diagonal 1 and Gaussian coefficient prior/ridge lambda 1e-4. Original FF has trainable biases/hidden layers, no explicit weight decay and 2000 steps of early training. Sharing B and Y therefore does not isolate removal of nonlinearity: differences may arise from mean, regularization and optimization. This retrospective development comparison cannot establish a prospective selector or causal mechanism.

resources.process_cpu_seconds: user+system separately recorded, not confused with wall duration

failure: New root required; append per-case solve/score journals, retain partial outputs and failures; no truth scoring if any of24 predictions missing/failed. Budget or signal stops rather than shortening cohort. No changed-source continuation.
costs: Per-case kernel/eigen/Cholesky/response/variance/save wall times, total invocation and CPU-phase wall, user/system CPU seconds, peak RSS (Linux KiB converted tobytes, Darwin bytes). Shared CPU timings are not exclusive benchmarks.
limits: Two development images, one saved noise realization and pretrained FF seed0 only
Horizontal coverage improvements do not identify the full2D spectrum
RBF/RF priors use fixed unit point variance and may mismatch actual images
Old FF is nonlinear and trained; these are conditional linear controls, not a derived equivalence
No choice among controls; all fixed arms retained
Same B and observations do not causally isolate nonlinear hidden layers from mean, regularization or optimization differences
Phase observation sets are nonnested; nonperiodic target nearest-distance histograms and continuous periodic maxgap measure different geometry; neither directly explains PSNR
